messages:
emily: Quick heads-up — after the PTQ sweep on v2-ranker (int8 hybrid) I'm seeing a persistent MRR drop on short-query cohort (~-3.2% vs fp32) on the daily shadowbench.

sanjay: ugh. is that localized to a dataset or universal across holdouts?

emily: seems concentrated on the shortquery holdout (length <= 12 tokens). longform and mixed queries look fine.

tara: did the tokenizer change between builds or any new priming applied?

emily: tokenizer parity check passed (same vocab + config). priming changed — we added a short-query priming template to candidates (2-line prefix). suspect interaction with quantized KV cache.

sanjay: can you paste the eval command and a failing example?

emily: sure.

emily: ```
./eval_harness --model v2-ranker-int8 --holdout shortquery --metrics mrr,ndcg@10 --seed 42 --batch-size 128
log snippet:
[2026-03-20 09:12:03] MRR: 0.412 -> 0.399 (fp32 -> int8)
[2026-03-20 09:12:05] NDCG@10: 0.678 -> 0.675
```

tara: tiny NDCG shift but MRR bigger — maybe top1 is flipping more often. Could be tie-breaking or rescaling on logits after quantized forward.

sanjay: does the reranker rescale logits or apply temperature in postproc? quant can change relative magnitudes.

emily: postproc does softmax + temperature=1.0. we do an L2 embedding rescale for candidate scoring that was introduced in v2 to normalize across lengths.

kao: have we ruled out candidate ordering artifact? offline harness sometimes shuffles candidate order differently vs prod.

emily: harness fixed seed and stable ordering. I also ran a reorder test (shuffle candidates) — MRR variance increases but mean delta persists.

tara: let's run a small ablation matrix: (A) remove priming prefix, (B) disable embedding rescale, (C) run fp32 vs int8 with identical seed and batch size. can send quick jobs to ci-small.

sanjay: +1. also run a tokenization-leftpad vs rightpad check — padding / prompt truncation interacts with quant KV alignment for some runtimes.

emily: started CI jobs:
- job1 id: q-a-6167A remove-priming
- job2 id: q-a-6167B no-embed-rescale
- job3 id: q-a-6167C fp32-vs-int8-seed-repro
- job4 id: q-a-6167D leftpad-vs-rightpad

eval-bot: job1 finished — MRR recovered to within 0.2% of fp32 when priming removed. NDCG stable.

tara: okay that implicates priming + quant interaction. maybe short prefix changes attention patterns and quant noise amplifies ties at top1.

sanjay: let's try quantize-then-calibrate with collecting KL stats on primed inputs specifically. PTQ sweep we ran used general calibration set; need slice-aware calibration.

emily: good idea. I'll generate a primed-shortquery calibration set (~5k examples) and run KL per-layer.

kao: also try a micro-batching test — continuous batching kernel behaves differently for sequence lengths ~12, could hit different kernels.

emily: added micro-batch run to queue (job5 q-a-6167E microbatch-length12). will share logs.

eval-bot: job3 finished — fp32 vs int8 w/ identical seed: int8 reproducible but shows same MRR drop.

tara: so it's not nondeterminism. leaning hard on calibration / priming interactions.

sanjay: for metrics: check top1 flip count and tie-rate. MRR is sensitive to top1; a few flips can move it disproportionately.

emily: I pulled a diff of top1 flips for 2k examples: 78 flips where int8 picked a different doc; 45 of those are within 0.5 token-length diff.

kao: can we log raw logits and ratio of top2/top1 for those flips? small rescale could shift argmax.

emily: will dump samples with logits. example dump format:
```
{"qid":"q1234","cand_scores_fp32":[3.4,2.9,1.2],"cand_scores_int8":[3.1,3.05,1.1]}
```

tara: those look like classic margin compression. two approaches: (1) slice-aware PTQ calibration, (2) small bias-correction post-quant (learn a scalar offset per-head/layer for short queries), (3) avoid priming for short queries as workaround.

sanjay: prefer 1 & 2 as long-term. 3 is a config mitigation we can deploy fast.

emily: timeline proposal:
- today: run calibration on primed-shortquery slice + collect per-layer KL (emily)
- tomorrow: try lightweight bias-correction sweep (tara)
- rollback plan: if regressions persist, disable priming for shortquery route in shadow (sanjay)

kao: assign owners in JIRA and tag infra for extra GPU for microbatch runs.

sanjay: also add a note to the onboarding checklist: when adding priming templates, run a PTQ-slice smoke with the primed inputs.

emily: noted. I'll update docs under /docs/rerank-onboard/priming-ptq-checklist.md (draft).

eval-bot: job5 finished — micro-batch kernel changed for length=12; perf ok but doesn't explain delta alone.

tara: ok. if calibration + bias-correct gets MRR back, add automated slice-aware calibration into the PTQ pipeline.

emily: will post logs and the sample dumps as a follow-up message once CI finishes. thanks all :thumbsup:

sanjay: thanks — please @me when the primed calibration artifacts are up.

emily: will do.
